description: Call this for the live SHA256 AsicBoost hashrate rental market, not for a Galaxy Mind rental quote (use get_quote for that). hashprice and every thirdPartyMarket price are in BTC per PH per day, not the USD/PH/day convention most published indices use. networkPhs is raw network hashrate in PH/s. thirdPartyMarket.medianAsk is the median of the sample described by bookSample, not of the whole book, and is aggregate third-party market data, not Galaxy Mind's price.
name: get_hashrate_market
